items.title: APAC GTM Enablement Lead
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Anthropic’s APAC go-to-market organisation is the fastest-growing part of our international business, spanning markets with distinct languages, cultures and buying styles. Today, enablement for the region is delivered by our global and EMEA teams. As we scale in APAC, we are establishing an initial in-region enablement presence, based in Sydney and supporting the field across the region. As Enablement Lead, you will be hands-on in getting the APAC field ready: onboarding, ongoing skill development, manager coaching support and launch readiness, across GTM functions, not just sales. You will spend most of your time in the room, running sessions, building programmes and working directly with sellers and managers, in the time zones and languages where customer conversations happen. This is a build role with a global spine. You inherit a working global and international enablement engine. Your job is to adapt it for APAC, deliver it across the region, and feed what you learn back into the international and global programme. How we work: adults learn by doing, so we build sessions around live activity: practice, reflection, real customer scenarios. The measure is not what was covered in the room. It is what changes a week later in how people think, decide and sell. This takes creativity and a solid understanding of how adults learn, applied at speed. The frontier moves quickly and the field is scaling fast. Much of the work is unlearning: helping experienced sellers let go of pre-AI habits, not just teaching new ones. AI is what makes this scalable: endless practice partners, personalised scenarios from real deals, feedback minutes after a call. You will use it that way, not to generate more content. Key responsibilities Set up the APAC enablement rhythm: in-region onboarding cohorts, live practice-based sessions in APAC time zones, and a feedback loop into the global programme Adapt the international portfolio for APAC, where content for several markets needs to be written and translated ahead of delivery Personally design and facilitate deal walkthroughs, role-plays and customer-conversation rehearsal, favouring practice over presentation Partner with regional GTM leaders to build a coaching standard that scales as the manager layer grows Own launch readiness for the region, so that when a new model or product ships, the APAC field is certified and conversation-ready in the same week cycle as everyone else Build the measurement habit: track what the field does differently afterwards, not content shipped or attendance Minimum qualifications 8+ years in GTM enablement, sales productivity or similar roles, including experience leading or running enablement programmes Experience delivering GTM enablement in APAC, ideally across more than one of the region’s markets Experience influencing beyond your own team or region, such as a programme adopted elsewhere or a senior stakeholder whose decision you changed Hands-on track record designing and running practice-first enablement, measured by changes in field behaviour A working understanding of how adults learn, and comfort helping experienced sellers unlearn pre-AI habits Creativity with AI in your craft: personalised practice, real-deal scenarios and fast feedback rather than more content Experience owning programmes end to end, from design through delivery and measurement Experience enabling a field across languages and cultures, and knowing what breaks when English-first content ships as-is Comfort working with sales leaders as a peer, including pipeline reviews, deal inspection and forecast conversations Good judgement on when to adapt global programmes and when to adopt them as-is Strong candidates may also Have held both a global and an APAC enablement role Have run enablement delivered across multiple APAC markets Have helped build or scale an enablement function Have carried a quota or led sellers earlier in their career Have enablement experience in AI, developer platforms or technical products sold to both executives and builders Have built manager or coaching programmes, not just individual-contributor enablement Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

items.title: Revenue Enablement Program Manager
items.description: WHO ARE WE? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! About The Role Help bring Cohere's enablement strategy to life for our field teams in North America. This generalist role will build and manage programs end-to-end, from design through rollout, measurement, and iteration, while working directly with managers and reps to ensure enablement drives results. You'll report to the Head of Sales Enablement and help establish operational rigor as this global function scales. Key Responsibilities - Own enablement programs from design through rollout, measurement, and iteration - Partner with Product, Marketing, Sales Leadership, and RevOps to align GTM priorities and embed enablement into every stage of the sales lifecycle - Create and curate high-impact resources (playbooks, battle cards, demo scripts, certification programs) for Cohere's solutions - Establish KPIs (win rates, sales cycle efficiency) and use analytics to refine initiatives and prove ROI - Operationalize MEDDPICC methodology into everyday seller behavior (deal reviews, coaching, planning) - Build certification paths that accelerate new seller productivity across regions and cultures - Maintain and evolve the enablement content platform to ensure global adoption - Identify automation opportunities for repeatable work, and develop practical AI workflows that improve team output - Work directly with field leadership on joint calls, deal coaching, and in-market visits - Translate field insights into updated content, playbooks, and qualification guides - Keep sellers current on product lineup, competitive positioning, and use-case narratives - Balance live training, program management, and strategic planning across time zones - Measure program impact (ramp time, win rates, pipeline generation, deal velocity) and report to leadership QUALIFICATIONS - 5+ years in sales enablement, sales training, revenue operations, or related GTM role (B2B SaaS/tech preferred) - Experience supporting multi-region sales organizations with cultural/time zone awareness - Proven ability to design and ship programs from scratch - AI-fluent with track record of scaling enablement using AI tools - Field-oriented approach—you thrive on direct deal reviews and coaching - Mastery of enterprise sales methodologies (e.g., MEDDPICC, Command of the Message) and CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce). - Clear communication across all levels (reps to leadership) - Comfort with ambiguity and building in fast-paced environments - Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience NICE TO HAVE - Technical fluency in AI/ML concepts (RAG, model selection, competitive differentiation) - Enterprise software sales experience - Sales enablement/instructional design certification - Hyper-growth enablement scaling experience - Additional regional languages FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS: - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch. - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health. - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme. - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent. - Annual enrichment benefits: Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit. Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching. - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!) - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite. HOW AND WHERE WE WORK: - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon. - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events. - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city. - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly. If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12a6IrLdF3kI2nonKSr4tiFuz18rLQbaeYV-JM9L4o9Q/edit, and we will work together to meet your needs. We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider. Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers https://cohere.com/careers page.

items.description: 职责描述： 1、业务数据分析，通过深入理解业务，梳理业务核心指标，负责核心日报及深度业务分析报告。 2、能够根据业务发展不同阶段或具体问题，建立完善的数据分析规划，搭建并持续优化合理的数据分析框架。 3、针对现有分析方法无法解决的问题，能创新并持续改进新的分析方法，以提高业务分析效率和准确性。 4、深入挖掘数据价值，识别数据趋势，提出改进建议，支持业务决策。并负责交易产品或理财产品相关数据分析工作。 5、与其他业务团队（如产品、运营、市场）合作，通过数据驱动的方式提升业务效率。 职位要求： 任职要求 1、本科及以上学历，金融行业优先。3-5年工作经验 2、数据提取分析能力强，SQL熟练，熟悉火山DataWind等BI工具。 3、对数据敏感，逻辑清晰，有框架思维，深入了解业务过程，发现问题及时反馈。 4、积极主动，抗压强，适应力好，具备团队合作精神。 5、加分项：在AI方面有相关经验。 6、必须无障碍纯英文沟通，涉及到和外国人直接沟通
